Komplexes Säuremodell liefert1,1/2/11mg/L; Ressourcenbilanz trennt Frischzufuhr/Rückführung und aktualisiert B auf2,00kg/kg und3,15kWh/kg bei20kg akzeptiertem Produkt. Salzphase fordert neue belegte Annahme statt erfundener Zahl. Ganze HB-Rohstoff/Klima- und Säure/Basen-Recherchefälle bleiben nur im jeweiligen HB-Scope.
mappings.operatorSpecificAuthorRationaleEn: Own analogue AND digital searching/opening/reading with an actually accessible additional source, locations, authors and marked quotation remains mandatory. Complex acid model yields1.1/2/11mg/L; resource balance separates fresh input/circulation and updatesB to2.00kg/kg and3.15kWh/kg for20kg accepted output. A salt phase needs a newly evidenced assumption rather than an invented number. Complete HB resource/climate and acid/base research cases retain their HB-only context.

Ganze gesellschaftlichen Ethanol-Folgenfälle bleiben erhalten.
mappings.operatorSpecificAuthorRationaleEn: Derive all five ethical/environmental/economic/social/safety criteria from the case, weigh feasible options and opportunities/risks with a justified strategy. Subsidy, changed returns, language/access and sponsorship selectively revise decisions while keeping chemical data separate. Preserve whole societal ethanol-consequence cases.
mappings.boundariesDe: B5 trägt Kriterien-Handlungsoptionen-Abwägung, keine einzig richtige Gesamtentscheidung, universelle Kennzahl oder persönliche Arzneimittelwahl. Alle ganzen Originalfälle, Kriterienentwicklung und frischer Transfer bleiben zusätzlich verbindlich.
mappings.boundariesEn: B5 supports criteria/action options/weighing, not one correct global decision, universal metric or personal medicine choice. All complete original cases, criterion derivation and fresh transfer remain additionally binding.
mappings.sourceStageCourseAndContext: DE-BB SekII end-of-qualification process standard; common GK/LK operator, differentiated depth and independence remain. This finite partial contribution creates no universal duty to the complete own cases or whole-source completion.
